comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
One of two Ancient Ganador superbosses which can be encountered during Ganador campaigns, and the stronger variant as indicated by the blood-red outline of his icon. For the weaker variant, visit Dictator Perpetuo instead.

Note that quote marks indicate Google Translated Japanese data. The rundown is as follows:

Map Type: Vortex (located "Northwest in the vortex")
Stats: Durability 9999, Crew 930
Special Effect: "Improve artillery power Creepy spell" / all-fleet magic attack (but like all Ganador super-bosses, this is only used if you provoke him with magic items such as an Amulet of the Sun)

Upon defeat, this boss can randomly drop the following:

Caesar's Gladius (MA item)
Archaia Kranos (MA item)
Dittatore (MA item)
Special Large 2-decked Hull
Argos' Shipbuilding Records

However! Before you go rushing off to farm Argos ship records or the like, please understand that the above loot table is taken from a Japanese UWO wiki. While MA player equipment is confirmed to be unchanged, I would be amazed if some of the other highly coveted/valuable goodies were not removed/substituted for Maris international server.

And sadly I cannot beat Ancient Ganadors, so unless other players or the GMs wish to state what the new loot tables are, please don't get your hopes up too high.

Cheers.
